note.en: The rendered HTML matches, but the reference reuses the blockquote paragraph as the title and maps the marker line on `alert_open`, while the current package emits a dedicated `alert_title` token for it.

note.en: The reference lowercases the written name before capitalizing the default title (`[!TIP]` → `Tip`), while the current package preserves the written casing (`TIP`); this is an intentional title style difference.
note.zh: 参考包把写出的名称转为小写后再首字母大写（`[!TIP]` → `Tip`），当前包保留写出的大小写（`TIP`），属有意的标题样式差异。

note.en:
The reference strips the marker from the first inline token but keeps its paragraph, so the marker line or an empty quoted line leaves a meaningless `

note.zh:

`；当前包会消费标记行。

note.en: With a nested blockquote the reference emits its alert `` before the inner `` (and converts the outer quote for `> > [!note]`), producing unbalanced markup; the current package keeps the tags balanced.
note.zh: 遇到嵌套 blockquote 时，参考包会先输出告警 `` 再输出内层 ``（并且对 `> > [!note]` 转换外层引用），产生不配对的标记；当前包保持标签配对。

note.en: The reference accepts a marker without a body and renders an empty alert, while the current package requires at least one body line and keeps the marker as a literal blockquote; both are valid syntax designs.
note.zh: 参考包接受没有正文的标记并渲染空告警，当前包要求至少一行正文、把标记保留为普通 blockquote；两种语法设计都成立。

note.en: The reference treats trailing text after the marker as a custom title (`> [!note] Title`), while the current package requires the marker to occupy the line by itself; this is a reference-only syntax extension.
note.zh: 参考包把标记后的尾随文本当作自定义标题（`> [!note] Title`），当前包要求标记独占一行；这是参考包独有的语法扩展。

note.en: The reference's marker pattern accepts an optional backslash, so the escaped `\[!note]` still becomes an alert; the current package treats it as literal text as the markdown escaping convention requires.
note.zh: 参考包的标记正则接受可选的反斜杠，因此转义的 `\[!note]` 仍会被解析为告警；当前包按 markdown 转义约定将其视为字面文本。

note.en: The reference searches the whole first inline token, so a marker on a later blockquote line (e.g. after `<hr>`) still becomes an alert and the preceding block is moved inside it; the current package only accepts the marker on the blockquote's first line.
note.zh: 参考包在整个首个内联 token 中搜索标记，因此 blockquote 后续行（如 `<hr>` 之后）的标记仍会变成告警，前面的块被移入告警内部；当前包只接受 blockquote 首行的标记。

notes.en: `deep: true` is enabled on the current package because the reference transforms every outermost blockquote after block parsing and therefore recognizes alerts at any nesting depth; the comparison covers nested blockquotes and alerts inside list items.
notes.zh: 当前包启用了 `deep: true`，因为参考包在块解析后转换每个最外层 blockquote，从而能识别任意嵌套深度上的告警；对比覆盖了嵌套 blockquote 和列表项内的告警。

notes.en: The reference's default GitHub SVG icons are disabled with `icons: {}` because the current package has no icon option. This is a documented default-markup difference, not a normalization: with default options the reference title contains an inline `<svg>`, while the current title contains only text.
notes.zh: 参考包默认的 GitHub SVG 图标通过 `icons: {}` 禁用，因为当前包没有图标选项。这是已记录的默认标记差异，而非归一化：使用默认选项时，参考包的标题包含内联 `<svg>`，当前包的标题则只包含文本。

notes.en: `deep: true` and `icons: {}` were measured to be irrelevant for the throughput gap: enabling `deep` costs about 1.6% only on the heavy corpus (one nested alert per unit) and 0% on the normal corpus, and disabling the reference icons changes the reference throughput by about 0.2%. The benchmark difference therefore follows the implementations, not the option mapping.
notes.zh: 经测量，`deep: true` 和 `icons: {}` 与吞吐量差距无关：启用 `deep` 仅在 heavy 语料（每个单元含一个嵌套告警）上带来约 1.6% 的开销，在 normal 语料上为 0%；禁用参考包图标使参考包吞吐量变化约 0.2%。因此基准测试差异来自实现本身，而不是选项映射。

notes.en:

notes.zh:
块级标签之间的空白会被归一化，因为参考包渲染其起始 `
` 和标题 `

` 时不带换行，而当前包使用 markdown-it 的默认块渲染器；属性顺序也由共享归一化器归一化。文本内容和代码中的空白保持不变。

notes.en:
The reference removes the marker from the first inline token and keeps the surrounding blockquote content. An alert whose first content line is empty therefore leaves an empty `

`, and a nested blockquote is hoisted into the alert. The current package consumes the marker line before parsing the body, so they are recorded as the `marker-line-empty-paragraph` and `nested-blockquote-structure` reference errors.
notes.zh:
参考包从第一个内联 token 中移除标记，并保留其周围的 blockquote 内容。因此，首个内容行为空的告警会留下空的 `

`，嵌套的 blockquote 会被提升到告警内。当前包在解析正文前消费标记行，因此它们被记录为 `marker-line-empty-paragraph` 和 `nested-blockquote-structure` 两个参考包错误。

notes.en: Parse-level differences are documented rather than normalized: the reference supports a custom title from trailing text (`> [!note] Title`), accepts a marker without any body, treats `\[!note]` as an alert, and finds a marker in the first inline token even after another block such as `<hr>`. The current package requires the marker line to contain only the marker, requires body content, and honors the escaped bracket; these differences are recorded as the `empty-alert-body`, `custom-title`, `escaped-marker` and `marker-after-block` issues.
notes.zh: 解析层面的差异只记录而不归一化：参考包支持用尾随文本自定义标题（`> [!note] Title`），接受没有正文的标记，把 `\[!note]` 视为告警，并且即使标记前还有 `<hr>` 等其他块，也能在第一个内联 token 中找到标记。当前包要求标记行只包含标记、要求有正文，并尊重转义的方括号；这些差异记录为 `empty-alert-body`、`custom-title`、`escaped-marker` 和 `marker-after-block` 问题。

notes.en: Default title casing differs: the reference lowercases the marker before capitalizing it (`[!TIP]` → `Tip`), while the current package capitalizes the written name and preserves its casing (`[!TIP]` → `TIP`).
notes.zh: 默认标题的大小写处理不同：参考包先把标记转为小写再首字母大写（`[!TIP]` → `Tip`），当前包则把写出的名称首字母大写并保留原有大小写（`[!TIP]` → `TIP`）。

notes.en: Both sides use the same five case-insensitive alert names and the default `markdown-alert` class prefix. The reference's `classPrefix` / `titles` options and the current package's `openRenderer` / `closeRenderer` / `titleRenderer` hooks have no counterpart on the other side and are left at their defaults.
notes.zh: 双方使用相同的五个不区分大小写的告警名称和默认的 `markdown-alert` 类前缀。参考包的 `classPrefix` / `titles` 选项与当前包的 `openRenderer` / `closeRenderer` / `titleRenderer` 钩子在对方都没有对应项，均保持默认值。

notes.en: Scaling: the reference scans a blockquote's token range once per outermost blockquote and the current package scans each alert body once, so `alert-rows`, `long-alert-body` and `nested-alerts` all grow linearly; no superlinear path was found.
notes.zh: 扩展性：参考包对每个最外层 blockquote 扫描一次其 token 范围，当前包对每个告警正文扫描一次，因此 `alert-rows`、`long-alert-body` 和 `nested-alerts` 均呈线性增长；未发现超线性路径。
